## Research interests

Macroevolution, macroecology and conservation; diversity patterns and their
responses to climate change; phylogenetic and functional diversity; the
biogeography of mountains and tropical rainforests; reproducible large-scale
biodiversity analysis.

## Skills

- **Comparative and spatial analysis** — integrative phylogenetic approaches,
  spatial methods and large datasets (distribution, molecular, ecological and trait
  data) applied to fundamental questions in evolutionary biology: diversity patterns
  at large geographic scales, species distribution modelling, mega-phylogeny
  reconstruction, biogeographic history, population genetics.
- **Scientific software** — development of research software for biogeography,
  including [BioGeoSyn](DataCode.qmd).
- **Computing** — R, Perl, Linux / HPC, ArcGIS.
- **Laboratory** — DNA extraction, PCR and related molecular techniques.
